name: Stanford University
summary: Stanford is a private research university in California, founded in 1885 and opened in 1891. First-year applicants apply to the university rather than to a major. Stanford is need-blind for US citizens and permanent residents but treats a request for financial aid as a factor in admission for international applicants.

scholarships.name: Stanford need-based financial aid (international students)
scholarships.eligibility: International applicants must indicate on the admission application that they will apply for aid; the request is a factor in admission and aid funds for international students are limited. Applicants should submit the CSS Profile (or ISAFA if the CSS Profile is unavailable). International students who do not request aid when applying are not eligible to apply for aid later.

opportunities.name: Undergraduate Research (VPUE)
opportunities.description: The Vice Provost for Undergraduate Education dedicates nearly $7.5 million a year to support about 1,200 students in research projects; roughly one third of students use VPUE research funding at some point.

opportunities.name: Bing Overseas Studies Program
opportunities.description: Lets Stanford undergraduates study abroad while remaining enrolled at Stanford; about 900 students (around 50% of a class year) study away on Stanford programs each year.
